expectations.evidence: Two elements: container animates+clips, inner content measured via RO. 'Never measure the animating element itself.'
RO on content re-measures on font swap/image/async/resize; releases to auto after expand.
Explicitly pins px then releases to height:auto on transitionend; handles auto->0 by pinning current px + forced reflow then rAF to 0.
useLayoutEffect for measure + pin; borderBoxSize; first-commit gate to avoid flash. (No Math.ceil.)

Puts padding on inner wrapper and discusses box-sizing/padding vs scrollHeight, but does not establish a BFC (flow-root) nor explicitly address child margin collapse; the padding mitigation is incidental and unreasoned.
